story.iWant: to organize the codebase into a monorepo with packages/ directory
story.soThat: Common SDK and plugins can be developed, built, and published independently from core Holo

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A packages/ directory exists at the project root
npm workspaces is configured in root package.json
Existing src/ directory remains unchanged (private core)

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Specification - Foundation & Monorepo Setup
doc.snippet: Defines root package.json structure with workspaces config pattern ["packages/*"], TypeScript composite configuration, and ESLint import boundary rules. Specifies "private": true for root to prevent accidental publishing.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR56: Provider plugins are extracted to packages/provider-{name}/ directories. FR57: Core Holo types are separated from provider-specific types. FR58-61: Clear import boundaries enforced between core, common, and plugins.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR81: Core Holo engine code (queue, orchestration, Holo format) remains in private repository. FR82-83: Common SDK and official plugins published to public NPM. FR84: Plugin contracts expose only extension points, not core implementation.

doc.title: Holo Architecture
doc.snippet: Proposed structure separates core/ (pure TS), api/ (SDK clients), and server/ (Node runtime). Clear boundaries enable core extraction as standalone library. Dependency flow: server → api → core → nothing.

doc.title: Epics Document
doc.snippet: Technical notes specify npm workspaces (not yarn/pnpm for MVP), root package.json with "workspaces": ["packages/*"], and workspace packages can reference each other using package names (e.g., @holokai/common/plugin).

constraints.constraint: MUST NOT modify any code in src/ directory - all core Holo functionality must remain unchanged (AC #4)
MUST add "private": true to root package.json to prevent accidental publishing of core code (IP protection, FR81)
MUST preserve existing build and test workflows - all existing scripts must continue to work
Unidirectional dependency flow: packages → @holokai/common (future), NEVER packages → src/
Physical code separation matches logical IP boundaries - src/ is private proprietary, packages/ are public ecosystem
npm workspaces pattern: "workspaces": ["packages/*"] enables package discovery (not yarn/pnpm for MVP)
Workspace feature requires npm >= 7.x (bundled with Node.js >= 15)
NFR-EPIC1-5: All existing integration tests must pass after changes
NFR-EPIC1-6: Package builds must not block core Holo compilation

interface.name: npm workspaces configuration
interface.notes: Enables npm to recognize all subdirectories in packages/ as workspace packages. Workspaces are symlinked into node_modules/ for resolution.

interface.name: package.json private field
interface.notes: Prevents accidental publishing of root package to NPM. Critical for IP protection - ensures core code cannot be published.

interface.name: .gitignore workspace patterns
interface.notes: Ignores build artifacts and dependencies for all workspace packages. Pattern packages/*/dist matches any package's dist directory.

tests.standards: Testing framework: Jest with ts-jest preset for TypeScript support. Tests located in tests/ directory with pattern **/*.test.ts. Integration tests use testTimeout=30000 and runInBand flag. Existing test: tests/integration/providers/openai.test.ts validates OpenAI provider functionality. All tests must pass after workspace configuration to ensure no regression (AC #4, NFR-EPIC1-5).
